content.text: Resolved T-6007. The 4.3 pods crash because the quarterly hardening added `readOnlyRootFilesystem: true`, but Next.js needs to create `/app/.next/cache` at startup (logs show `EROFS` from `ImageOptimizerCache.init`). Fix is to mount an `emptyDir` at `/app/.next/cache` while keeping the read-only root filesystem.
